title: Review Arbiter Verdict
description: The output payload the review-arbiter returns when ruling on ONE code-review finding in the external-review pattern. This file defines the SHAPE and value domains ONLY; the ruling SEMANTICS (recommended-default rule, ALREADY_RESOLVED-vs-false-positive, the ESCALATE hatch, the three standing duties) live in the review-arbiter agent + the standard-judging constitution. `verdict` is the FULL arbiter set (see finding-verdict.schema.json); `severity` is the ONE anchored scale (see severity.schema.json). Return ONLY an object conforming to this schema.

evidence.description: The deciding file:line proof — what was verified in the code.

recommended_action.description: The default to apply. REQUIRED for a technical call — the arbiter never punts a technical decision to the human.

secondary_actions.description: Additional outcomes beyond the primary verdict, for a genuinely compound ruling. OPTIONAL — omit when there are none.

already_resolved_by.description: The SHA that already fixed the finding. OPTIONAL — present ONLY when verdict == ALREADY_RESOLVED.

option_completeness.description: Standing duty 1: the disposition set is complete, or the missing/compound outcome is named. REQUIRED every time ('none found after looking' is valid; silence is not).

shared_blind_spot.description: Standing duty 2: an agreed position the code contradicts, or 'none found after an independent read'. REQUIRED every time.

confidence.description: Standing duty 3: the arbiter's stated confidence in the ruling. REQUIRED every time.
